documentationChunks.content:
The Arcade Google Search MCP Server uses the [SerpAPI](https://serpapi.com/) to get results from a Google search.
- **Secret:**
  - `SERP_API_KEY`: Your SerpAPI API key.
    <Callout type="info">
      Setting the `SERP_API_KEY` secret is only required if you are
      [self-hosting](/guides/deployment-hosting/configure-engine) Arcade. If you're
      using Arcade Cloud, the secret is already set for you. To manage your
      secrets, go to the [Secrets
      page](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets) in the Arcade
      Dashboard.
    </Callout>

summary:
Google Search is Google's web search engine. This toolkit lets agents search Google through [SerpApi](https://serpapi.com/) and get the organic results back.

## Capabilities

- **Web search**: run a Google search and return the organic results in rank order.
- **Result details**: each result includes its title, link, and snippet.
- **Result count**: choose how many results to return (5 by default).

## Secrets

- `SERP_API_KEY`: a SerpApi API key. SerpApi runs the Google searches for this toolkit. Create a SerpApi account, then copy your private key from the [SerpApi API key page](https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key). Searches count against your SerpApi plan's monthly quota, and the free plan includes a limited number.

Store the secret in Arcade as described in the [Arcade secrets docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets), or manage it in the [Arcade dashboard](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
